rule: Composed sentences (see recipe). Trial id = <participant>-<split>-<nn>. detail_sha256 hashes the press ids (<recording key>#<press index>) of each character.

recipe.pool_rule: day-2 (session T2) presses; recording order 1 -> cal pool, order >= 2 -> test pool
recipe.sentence_rule: Tatoeba held-out list; keep typeable a-z/space sentences with 12-50 chars and >= 2 words; dedupe; permute with default_rng(seed); first half -> cal texts, second half -> test texts; participant k takes slice k of each half
recipe.press_rule: per character: a random unused press of that character from the pool (rng shared, participants in numeric order, cal then test)

train-day1.rule: Cross-session regime: all session T1 recordings of all 19 participants.

train-calibrated.rule: Session-calibrated regime: T1 plus half of the T2 recordings, cross-fitted (the other half is predicted); see experiments/2026-11-11-emg-toronto/train.py.

train-xsubject.rule: Cross-subject regime: 4 folds leave participants out (no data of the user).
